{{Quote|It was Admiral Hyshiri. She was very clear. No survivors. No witnesses...|[[Jilo Del]] on Admiral Hyshiri|<ref name="Krallet" />}}
'''Hyshiri''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Admiral/Legends|admiral]] in the [[Imperial Navy (Sith Empire)|navy]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Third Galactic War]]. After discovering that her sister, who was planning on defecting to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], was hiding in a colony, Hyshiri hired the mercenary, [[Jilo Del]], to eradicate the entire colony and leave no survivors or witnesses. After revealing the true reason behind her actions, Hyshiri betrayed Del and turned him over to the [[Imperial Army (Sith Empire)|Imperial Army]], hoping to sever all ties with her defecting sister. Del would then reveal Hyshiri's involvement to his [[Torture/Legends|interrogator]], [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Acota]].<ref name="Krallet" /><ref name="Jilo Del">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=codex|Jilo Del}}</ref>
